scope: Reusable note and applicability contracts only; no project decisions or approvals instantiated
namespace_rules: Geographic jurisdiction, operating mode, component condition, review status, rule applicability and authority authorization are distinct.
State profiles are research starting points, never automatic adopted project defaults.
Guidance, public plan examples and product test reports do not independently establish an adopted rule or project approval.
note_release_checks: Resolve actual authority territory, permit/activity basis and rule/product edition/locator.
Check applicability facts, exceptions, current legal effect, amendments and errata.
Resolve all placeholders and reference targets; withhold unsupported notes.
Record responsible reviewer and evidence; verify any separate authority/utility milestones.
Schema success and eligible-for-issue metadata do not grant professional or external approval.
